Prompt Refinement Workflow

1. Fix (On-device)
Corrects grammar, spelling, and local prompt quality rules. Preserves original structure and makes small adjustments. Recommended as the initial step.

2. Upgrade (On-device)
Applies structured engineering templates (CRISPE/RISEN) and configures skill-based roles offline. Moderately structures the prompt.

3. Rewrite (AI Cloud)
Uses the Gemini model to optimize the prompt completely, using compiled structural guidelines and rules. Rewrites the prompt significantly.

Recommended Flow: Fix first to clean rules -> Upgrade to structure layout -> Rewrite if you need advanced AI polishing.
